report_scope: formal full2638 CV-Bench conclusion for the frozen corrected-L2 / Prompt protocol
formal_statement: Formal full2638 CV-Bench evaluation of the frozen corrected-L2 / Prompt protocol. The Selector path is a software bridge only; no FPGA, latency or acceleration claim is made.

primary_metric.rule: the only primary metric for every arm and every comparison

unweighted_metric.rule: secondary diagnostic only; never the CV-Bench primary and never decision-driving

prompt_plus_corrected_l2_integer.formula: accepted integer semantic Q0.15 + corrected patch L2 Q0.15, lambda=0.5

checks: exactly 2638 identical unique sample_ids in the manifest and all five inputs
no duplicate sample_id in any input
every arm record carries arm / budget=96 / region_grid=3 / cap=16
every arm record manifest_sha256 equals the pinned full-manifest SHA256
every arm record task/source matches the full manifest
every non-bypass record emits K=96; bypass emits G == full_llm_visual_tokens
selected_group_indices strictly ascending, length == K, hash re-verified
prompt arm checkpoint hashes match the config pins; no-prompt arms carry none
input grid identical across the three corrected-L2 arms

decision.reason: quantization gate passes (CI lower -0.004192 >= -0.02) but prompt_minus_integer_l2 CI lower -0.005430 <= 0.0

limitations: Software Selector bridge only; no FPGA, latency or acceleration claim.
Dense and the old current-integer selector are descriptive references only and never drive the decision.
The decision uses score(...)["cv_bench_accuracy"] exclusively, via paired stratified bootstrap CI lower bounds.
Forbidden primary metrics (pointing/grounding/ndcg/retained_mass) are never reported.
